verification: 2023 is supported only as CoreWeave's start, not the first building's. Dgtl Infra (undated analyst page) says CoreWeave's Plano facility at 1000 Coit Road 'became operational at the end of 2023'; that would be medium (vendor write-up) for the CoreWeave deployment (initial 12 MW). But Community Impact (2023-07-26) says the facility is in 'an existing building', and Dallas Innovates (2023-07-25) traces the building from Alcatel to Countrywide Financial to Bank of America, which sold it 'during a data center consolidation' before Lincoln Rackhouse took it over in 2018. That wording implies, but does not state outright, earlier data center use (inference). No page opened gives a start year for that earlier use. CoreWeave's own release (2023-07-25) is a target only ('to be fully operational by December 31, 2023'). If the study dates this site by the CoreWeave load rather than the first building, end-2023 per Dgtl Infra is the usable figure at medium.
